issue.title: GUI tests: agent-bulk-visibility's fixed 5s wait and agent-connect-* cases near the 180s timeout go red under load
issue.body:
Seen 2026-10-17 05:28-06:08 (+0800), macOS 26.2 arm64. The run was the full GUI suite (`node --test --test-concurrency=4 tests/*.test.cjs`) at cb41a69aa (a release series on ec6454395), with load around 250-390.

**1. Four tests hit the runner's 180s per-test timeout in the full run:**
```
✖ chromium de: bulk visibility, retry and persistence (180007ms)                      agent-bulk-visibility
✖ chromium en 1000 Get started: a switched-off agent with every model hidden opens its list to pick one (180002ms)   agent-connect-all-hidden
✖ chromium zh no_models: connecting with no models to give says what to do (180001ms)  agent-connect-no-models
✖ webkit en no_models: connecting with no models to give says what to do (180000ms)    agent-connect-no-models
```
I ran the three files alone, at the same time:
- On origin/main df3734b95, just fetched: 38/38 pass.
- At cb41a69aa: 37/38. All four tests above passed. One other test was red:
```
not ok 9 - webkit ja: bulk visibility, retry and persistence
  error: 'page.waitForFunction: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.'
  at agent-bulk-visibility.test.cjs:118:18
```
Line 118 waits a fixed 5s for `.ag-manage-result` to read "3" after Hide all. The release series doesn't touch the agents manager; its app.js changes are plugin panels, the Plugins tab and the Plugins sidebar dot. The file passed 10/10 twice more at cb41a69aa, at load 340-390.

`chromium en 1000` in agent-connect-all-hidden took 104.7s even when it passed, so 180s isn't much room under load.

Per the code standards, a timing test leaves room on both sides. Two things to fix:
- agent-bulk-visibility:118, and its siblings that wait a fixed 5s, should wait on the state with the file's normal timeout.
- agent-connect-all-hidden / agent-connect-no-models: find what one case spends ~100s on under load. That is too long for a single test.

comments.body:
Both failures came from waits and work the loaded machine stretched, not from the agents manager: the visibility save's result was awaited with the 5s the file gives a drawn state, while the write was still in flight, and each agent-connect case launched and closed its own browser and then let Playwright wait out the model list's pop-in animation.

The branch gives the waits for a server answer a 30s bound (the visibility result line, the list opening from the connect answer, the switch turning on, the refusal toast), launches one browser per file instead of one per case, runs `agent-connect-all-hidden` with reduced motion like `agent-bulk-visibility`, and replaces its 150ms sleep for the model save's POST with the fake's own signal. The click on a model row measured 918ms -> 35ms, and a case 2.1s -> 1.0s, idle.

A new case in `agent-bulk-visibility` holds the arrange answer 6.5s and waits for the result line. With the wait's bound put back to the file's default 5s it fails as reported (`page.waitForFunction: Timeout 5000ms exceeded.`); with the change it passes.

[fix/2629-gui-tests-agent-bulk-visibility](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/2629-gui-tests-agent-bulk-visibility), commit 7c0ede7db7d18c138deaaf5763db9b662b4a65d0

Run at that head, Chromium and WebKit: `agent-bulk-visibility` 12/12, `agent-connect-all-hidden` 12/12, `agent-connect-no-models` 16/16; `go build ./...`, `go vet ./internal/gui/` and `go test ./internal/gui/ -count=1` clean. No product code changed.

This is a fork branch, ready to review; it makes no claim on the issue.
